title: 第15章 指点第16章 天才战开始
content_zh:
“柳家，柳若雪？”
秦浩眼中闪过一抹冷意。
这个他曾经深爱的女人，如今是他心中的痛！
刘卫点头，道：“不错！
而且，她还带来了两名万象殿外殿弟子。”
秦浩疑惑道：“什么意思？”
柳若雪刚去万象殿没多久，此次返回天水城，怎么还有外殿弟子跟随？
刘卫斟酌了下，缓缓道：“秦浩，这事我也是刚刚知道，柳若雪拜入万象殿后，她的水属性武魂受到万象殿重视，并且，柳若雪不知道通过什么关系，傍上了一名万象殿内殿天才！”
“如今，他们已经确定了伴侣关系，因此柳若雪返回天水城，此人特意安排两名外殿弟子保护。”
“这名内殿天才，名叫雷震！”
顿了顿，刘卫继续道：“雷家，在万象殿乃是一股大势力，雷家老祖，是万象殿内殿长老之一！”
说到这里，刘卫目露担忧之色。
他担心秦浩无法接受，心里受到刺激。
不过，让刘卫意外的是，秦浩听完，脸色十分平静。
“趋炎附势，借鸡生蛋，这种女人，我秦浩看不上！”
秦浩语气淡漠，“不过，我说过，我会让柳若雪后悔，万象天才战，我会向世人证明，柳若雪究竟有多么愚昧无知。”
“而且，这也是我追逐武道的第一步！”
“刘叔，你看着吧，我会夺得万象天才战第一名！”
刘卫心中悸动，大笑一声，期待道：“好，秦浩，我等着你在万象天才战的表现！”
……

秦家，演武场。
砰！
砰！
砰！
数道身影从擂台上坠落下来，横七竖八躺在地上哀嚎着。
小片刻后，这几人才龇牙咧嘴的从地上爬起，朝着擂台敬佩道：“秦枫师兄，秦鹏师兄，你们太厉害了，我们这么多人同时进攻，都在你们手上支撑不过两秒钟！”
擂台上，赫然站着两名身着万象殿外殿服饰的少年。
这两人，正是秦枫和秦鹏。
秦枫，上上届万象天才战前三名，而秦鹏，则是上届拜入万象殿。
秦鹏背负双手，傲然道：“我在万象殿苦修三年，不说在外殿排名多少，同境界武者中，能超过我的不过一手之数！
你们区区淬体境四重、五重，能在我手上过两招，很不错了！
尤其是你，再努力修炼，下届万象天才战，可以尝试冲击前三！”
“多谢秦鹏师兄指点！”
那名被点名的秦家子弟脸露喜色，连忙拱手道。
秦鹏点点头，说道：“下一个，谁来？”
“我来，秦鹏师兄也指点指点我！”
“我，秦鹏师兄点我！”
顿时，围绕擂台的众多秦家子弟，纷纷狂热起来。
“我来！”
“秦方，见过两位师兄！”

这时，秦方一跃跳上擂台。
秦枫和秦鹏很享受被人崇敬的感觉。
两人微微点头，秦枫淡笑道：“原来是秦方你这个小家伙，几年没见，秦方，你长大了！
听说张元吉长老给你检测出了三品武魂，不错，他日我秦家必然能再多一名万象殿弟子！”
content_en:
"Liu family, Liu Ruoxue?"
A coldness flashed in Qin Hao's eyes.
This woman he once loved deeply is now the pain in his heart!
Liu Wei nodded and said: "Not bad!
Moreover, she also brought two disciples from the outer hall of Wanxiang Hall. "
Qin Hao asked doubtfully: "What do you mean?"
Liu Ruoxue had just gone to the Wanxiang Palace not long ago. When she returned to Tianshui City this time, why were there disciples from the outer palace following her?
Liu Wei considered it for a moment and said slowly: "Qin Hao, I just learned about this. After Liu Ruoxue joined the Wanxiang Hall, her water-attribute martial spirit was valued by the Wanxiang Hall. Moreover, Liu Ruoxue got involved with a genius in the inner hall of the Wanxiang Hall through some unknown relationship!"
"Now that they have confirmed their partnership, Liu Ruoxue returned to Tianshui City. This person specially arranged for two outer palace disciples to protect him."
"This genius in the inner palace is named Lei Zhen!"
After a pause, Liu Wei continued: "The Lei family is a big force in the Wanxiang Palace. The ancestor of the Lei family is one of the elders of the inner hall of the Wanxiang Palace!"
Speaking of this, Liu Wei looked worried.
He was worried that Qin Hao would not be able to accept it and would be stimulated in his heart.
However, what surprised Liu Wei was that Qin Hao looked very calm after listening.
"I, Qin Hao, don't like this kind of woman who follows the trend and lays eggs on the back of a chicken!"
Qin Hao's tone was indifferent, "However, I said that I will make Liu Ruoxue regret it. In the Wanxiang Genius Battle, I will prove to the world how ignorant Liu Ruoxue really is."
"Moreover, this is also my first step in pursuing martial arts!"
"Uncle Liu, just watch, I will win the first place in the Vientiane Genius Competition!"
Liu Wei's heart palpitated, he laughed loudly, and said expectantly: "Okay, Qin Hao, I'm waiting for your performance in the Wanxiang Genius Battle!"
…
Qin family, martial arts arena.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Several figures fell from the ring, lying on the ground in a mess, wailing.
After a short while, these few people got up from the ground with bared teeth, and said in admiration towards the ring: "Senior Brother Qin Feng, Senior Brother Qin Peng, you are so powerful. With so many of us attacking at the same time, your hands can't sustain it for more than two seconds!"
On the ring, two young men wearing the costumes of the outer hall of the Vientiane Palace stood impressively.
These two people were Qin Feng and Qin Peng.
Qin Feng was among the top three in the last Wanxiang Genius Competition, while Qin Peng was admitted to the Wanxiang Hall last time.
Qin Peng put his hands behind his back and said proudly: "I have been practicing hard in the Wanxiang Palace for three years. Regardless of my ranking in the outer palace, among the warriors of the same realm, there are only a handful of people who can surpass me!
You are only at the fourth or fifth level of the body tempering realm, but you can defeat two moves in my hands, which is very good!
Especially you, if you practice harder, you can try to hit the top three in the next Vientiane Genius Competition! "
"Thank you, Senior Brother Qin Peng, for your advice!"
The Qin family disciple who was named showed joy on his face and quickly raised his hands.
Qin Peng nodded and said, "Who is next?"
"I'll come, Senior Brother Qin Peng will give me some pointers!"
"Senior Brother Qin Peng, click on me!"
Suddenly, many Qin family disciples surrounding the arena became enthusiastic.
"I'll do it!"
"Qin Fang, I have met two senior brothers!"
At this time, Qin Fang jumped onto the ring.
Qin Feng and Qin Peng enjoyed the feeling of being respected by others.
The two nodded slightly, and Qin Feng smiled lightly and said: "It turns out it's Qin Fang, you little guy. I haven't seen you for a few years. Qin Fang, you have grown up!
I heard that Elder Zhang Yuanji detected a third-grade martial spirit for you. Yes, our Qin family will definitely have another Wanxiang Hall disciple in the future! "
